{{< include _style-block.md >}}

Specify, Update, Validate and Adjust stop at `density_df`. This page is the Use stage for pricing, which is the second half of the library. The theory behind the distortions and the allocation is in @Mildenhall2022a, and the bounds machinery follows @Mildenhall2022.

Pricing adds exactly one new frame, `augmented_df`, and everything priced is a read off it.
